## alerts

### `alerts_get`

**Reader**

Get alerts from LibreNMS with optional filters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `state` | integer \| string? |  |  | Filter the alerts by state: 0 = ok, 1 = alert, 2 = ack. Optional. |
| `severity` | string? |  |  | Filter the alerts by severity. Valid values: ok, warning, critical. Optional. |
| `alert_rule` | integer \| string? |  |  | Filter alerts by alert rule ID. Optional. |
| `order` | string? |  |  | How to order the output, default is by timestamp (descending). Can be appended by DESC or ASC to change the order. Optional. |
| `limit` | integer |  | `100` | Maximum number of results to return |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` | Number of results to skip (offset) for pagination |

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `alert_id` | integer | yes |  | The ID of the alert to retrieve. |

**Operator**

|---|---|---|---|---|

### `alert_rule_add`

**Admin** · **destructive**

Add a new alert rule to LibreNMS.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payload` | object | yes |  | Alert rule payload fields: - name (required): Rule name - builder (required): Rule builder JSON with conditions - devices (required): Array of device IDs or [-1] for all devices - severity (required): ok, warning, critical - count (optional): Trigger threshold count (default: 1) - delay (optional): Delay before alerting in seconds - interval (optional): Re-alert interval in seconds - mute (optional): Mute alerts (true/false) - invert (optional): Invert rule logic (true/false) - notes (optional): Rule notes - disabled (optional): Disable rule (0/1) |

### `alert_rule_edit`

**Admin** · **destructive**

Edit an existing alert rule in LibreNMS.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payload` | object | yes |  | Alert rule edit payload (must include rule_id field): - rule_id (required): Integer rule ID to edit. Without it LibreNMS would create a new   rule, so the tool refuses the call. - name: Rule name - builder: Rule builder JSON with conditions - devices: Array of device IDs or [-1] for all devices - severity: ok, warning, critical - count: Trigger threshold count - delay: Delay before alerting in seconds - interval: Re-alert interval in seconds - mute: Mute alerts (true/false) - invert: Invert rule logic (true/false) - notes: Rule notes - disabled: Disable rule (0/1) |

### `alert_rule_delete`

**Admin** · **destructive**

Delete an alert rule from LibreNMS by ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rule_id` | integer | yes |  | Alert rule ID to delete |

## devices

### `devices_list`

**Reader**

List devices from LibreNMS with optional filters.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `query` | object? |  |  | Query parameters for filtering devices. Examples: - {"type": "hostname", "query": "router"} - search by hostname substring - {"type": "os", "query": "linux"} - filter by operating system - {"type": "location", "query": "datacenter"} - filter by location - {"type": "up"} or {"type": "down"} - filter by status - {"order": "hostname ASC"} - sort results |
| `limit` | integer |  | `100` | Maximum number of results to return |
| `offset` | integer |  | `0` | Number of results to skip (offset) for pagination |

### `device_add`

**Admin** · **destructive**

Add a new device to LibreNMS.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `payload` | object | yes |  | Device add payload. Required and optional fields: - hostname (required): Device hostname or IP - version (optional): SNMP version (v1, v2c, v3). Default: v2c - community (required for v1/v2c): SNMP community string - authlevel (required for v3): noAuthNoPriv, authNoPriv, authPriv - authname (required for v3): SNMPv3 username - authpass (required for v3 with auth): Authentication password - authalgo (optional): MD5 or SHA - cryptopass (required for authPriv): Privacy password - cryptoalgo (optional): AES or DES - port (optional): SNMP port (default: 161) - transport (optional): udp or tcp - poller_group (optional): Poller group ID - force_add (optional): Skip ICMP/SNMP checks (true/false) - ping_fallback (optional): Add as ping-only if SNMP fails |

|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | yes |  | Device hostname or ID |
| `payload` | object | yes |  | Patchable device fields: - notes: Device notes/comments - purpose: Device purpose description - override_sysLocation: true/false to override SNMP location - location_id: Location ID to assign - poller_group: Poller group ID - ignore: 0/1 to ignore device in alerts - disabled: 0/1 to disable polling - snmp_disable: 0/1 to disable SNMP polling - display_template: Custom display name template (LibreNMS >= 26.5) - display: Custom display name (LibreNMS < 26.5 only; read-only since 26.5, use display_template) - type: Device type classification |

## graphs

### `device_graphs_list`

**Reader**

List the graph types available for a device.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | yes |  | Device hostname or device ID |

### `device_graph`

**Reader** · returns an image

Render a device-level graph as an image.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | yes |  | Device hostname or device ID |
| `graph_type` | string | yes |  | Graph type, as returned by device_graphs_list (e.g. 'device_icmp_perf', 'device_poller_perf', 'device_availability') |
| `from_time` | string? |  |  | Start of the time range, either a relative offset such as '-1d', '-6h' or '-1w', or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the LibreNMS default (-1d). |
| `to_time` | string? |  |  | End of the time range, either a relative offset or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now. |
| `width` | integer? |  |  | Graph width in pixels. |
| `height` | integer? |  |  | Graph height in pixels. |
| `legend` | boolean? |  |  | Whether to render the graph legend. |

### `port_graph`

**Reader** · returns an image

Render a per-port graph as an image, for example interface traffic.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `hostname` | string | yes |  | Device hostname or device ID |
| `ifname` | string | yes |  | Interface name as reported by LibreNMS, e.g. 'Po1' or 'Te2/7' |
| `graph_type` | string |  | `"bits"` | Graph type: 'bits' (traffic), 'upkts' (unicast packets), 'nupkts' (non-unicast packets), 'errors', or 'etherlike'. The LibreNMS names ('port_bits', ...) are accepted too. |
| `from_time` | string? |  |  | Start of the time range, either a relative offset such as '-1d', '-6h' or '-1w', or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the LibreNMS default (-1d). |
| `to_time` | string? |  |  | End of the time range, either a relative offset or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now. |
| `width` | integer? |  |  | Graph width in pixels. |
| `height` | integer? |  |  | Graph height in pixels. |
| `legend` | boolean? |  |  | Whether to render the graph legend. |

### `port_group_graph`

**Reader** · returns an image

Render a traffic graph for one or more ports, by port ID.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `port_ids` | integer[] | yes |  | One or more port IDs to plot on a single graph. Resolve names to IDs with ports_search_field or device_ports. |
| `from_time` | string? |  |  | Start of the time range, either a relative offset such as '-1d', '-6h' or '-1w', or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to the LibreNMS default (-1d). |
| `to_time` | string? |  |  | End of the time range, either a relative offset or a Unix timestamp. Defaults to now. |
| `width` | integer? |  |  | Graph width in pixels. |
| `height` | integer? |  |  | Graph height in pixels. |
| `legend` | boolean? |  |  | Whether to render the graph legend. |

Get services for a device from LibreNMS.
